audit.qualification: Three rotated repetitions of the unchanged16-workload diagnostic pilot. All raw samples, unfavorable changes, result/mode checks, startup/total/RSS/GC evidence retained. Source286, native argument candidate288 and VM call-entry candidate289 are separate. Emaxx allocation counters remain explicitly unavailable. These are not calibrated nine-round/three-sample measurements and cannot establish the locked3% acceptance criterion or universal correctness.

profiles.qualification: Separate2-second macOS sample profiles at1ms intervals, Emaxx running20 repetitions; prior separately retained GNU profiles remain the reference, using of the unchanged locked-size body. Instrumented durations are not performance evidence. All raw reports, process outcomes and sample trees are retained; no local full-validation job ran concurrently.

timing_entry.qualification: The full local process inventory includes unrelated applications and is omitted from publication. Its hash and the exact task-relevant empty competitor result are retained. All benchmark commands, outputs, measurements and unfavorable results remain in this archive.

scope.qualification: Three rotated repetitions of the unchanged16-case pilot across source286, native-argument candidate288 and VM-entry candidate289. Own executable/image/native inputs for each candidate; no build, validation or profiling job runs during timing. The earlier two-candidate timing queue was withdrawn while waiting, after native preparation and before any timed process. All actual timing samples and unfavorable results are retained. No workload, size, expectation, timeout or tolerance changed. Real allocation counters, calibration and the nine-round3% acceptance criterion remain unsatisfied.
